description: A single XAdES electronic signature extracted from an ADOC package, combining data from the XAdES signature XML file and the corresponding signable metadata entry.

filePath.description: Path to the XAdES signature XML file within the ZIP (e.g. META-INF/signatures/signatures0.xml)

level.description: XAdES conformance level inferred from which UnsignedSignatureProperties elements are present; null if the XAdES file could not be parsed

signingPurpose.description: Purpose declared in the signable metadata signingPurpose element

signer.description: Identity of the signer as declared in the signable metadata (name and position), distinct from the certificate subject which may contain a personal ID number.

contentRefsCount.description: Number of ds:Reference elements in SignedInfo that point to files (excludes the internal #fragment reference to SignedProperties)
